sources: https://mnrdr.usedirect.com/MinnesotaRDR/rdr/ search/place + search/grid + search/details, PlaceId 136, FacilityId 810 Bear Head Lake Campground (2027-06-15)
Esri World_Imagery with the ReserveMN site points overlaid

values.note: 73 drive-in sites in one wooded campground, 45 of them electric in two loops. Every drive-in site is a back-in; ReserveMN lists them at 32-77 ft, so all take a 23-ft rig. The DNR says the campground is not suitable for some large Class A motorhomes.

sites.source: DNR park record spk00109 ('73 semi-modern sites', 'Electric Sites 45 sites ... Two electric loops', 'RV Length Limit 60 feet', 'Back in pads available for RV campers. The campground is not suitable for some large Class A motorhomes.') + ReserveMN facility 810 (28 Drive-In at 33-71 ft, 45 Drive-In Electric at 32-77 ft; every one 'Back-in'), read 2026-11-11

hookups.source: ReserveMN facility 810 site details (20 Drive-In Electric sites list 'Amp' '20, 30, 50' or '50'; the rest '30'), read 2026-11-11

values.note: Showers, flush toilets and dump-station water are seasonal; vault toilets in the campground and water at the park office and Trail Center year-round.

facilities.source: DNR park record spk00109 ('Two shower buildings are located in the campground', 'Three modern restroom buildings, located in the campground', 'Vault Toilets ... Available year-round', 'Dump Station Seasonal', 'Year-round water is available at a water tap outside the park office and at the Trail Center'), read 2026-11-11

values.note: Some sites stay open for winter camping; the shower and restroom buildings close for the season.

season.source: DNR park record spk00109 ('Camping is available year-round', 'Some sites remain open for winter camping', 'The sanitation buildings are closed for the season') + ReserveMN facility 810 in season on every date read (2026-11-11 to 2026-12-01, 2027-03-01 to 2027-03-21), read 2026-11-11

note: Bear Head Lake State Park campground on a wooded point of Bear Head Lake near Ely, with docks and a fishing pier near the campground. ATVs and side-by-sides are not allowed in the park. --Claude
summary: DNR park record and ReserveMN read: 73 drive-in back-in sites (45 electric, up to 50 amp), all 32-77 ft, DNR 60-ft limit, camping year-round with seasonal showers/flush toilets/dump water; stored pull_through true was wrong (every site back-in). Fees left as the 2026-10-12 pass wrote them ($25/$35, unchanged on ReserveMN for June 2027). Not waterfront kept.
